sloka: सो ऽवर्धत तदा राम रावणान्तःपुरे शुभे ।रक्ष्यमाणो वरस्त्रीभिश्छन्नः काष्ठैरिवानलः ।। ७.१२.३१ ॥
transliteration: so 'vardhata tadā rāma rāvaṇāntaḥpure śubhe ।rakṣyamāṇo varastrībhiśchannaḥ kāṣṭhairivānalaḥ ।। 7.12.31 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, he then grew up in Ravana's beautiful inner palace, protected by excellent women, like a fire hidden by wood.
